items.summary: Enable MA for Thai Registration to support Terra team & Ceres team Release 15 Oct 2026 01:00
items.description:
Terra Service Release included:

• tmn-mobile-gateway (TMG)
• tmn-mobile-gateway3 (TMG3)
• user-profile-composite (UPC)
• cross-register-composite (XRC)
Ceres Service Release included:

• cross-channel-composite (XCC)
We plan to release Thai revamp registration flow, especially 4 PRDs.

• Add Self-Delete Wallet flow to support TMN Wallet Limit Case - Release 1
• PRD - Co-create Thai user profile from DTAC
• SML - Customer Profiling for TMN
• Enforce DOPA verification immediately following Thai ID card scanning within the “TMN Onboarding with DipChip” journey
So, please support to enable/disable MA for Thai Registration flow following the schedule within 15 Oct 2026 below:

• 00:00 – 01:00: (Block new applicants) Enable MA at the main gateway to prevent new users from creating Initial API calls, while allowing existing users in the onboarding flow to complete their transactions within 1 hour to minimize user experience impact.
• 01:00 – 01:30: Terra deployment.
• 01:30 – 02:00: Ceres deployment.
• 02:00: Disable MA, resume normal operations across all channels, and conduct sanity testing.
